rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese verb for the physical act of sneezing.

example.english: I sneeze as soon as I get to work in the morning.
example.traditional: 我朝早一返工就打乞嗤。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 jat1 faan1 gung1 zau6 daa2 hat1 ci1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a sneeze or one act of sneezing.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 daa2 zo2 go3 hat1 ci1
